title: UserDefinedLabel - Data API
description: Represents a label created by a user to help organize, track, and find records. This object is available in API version 61.0 and later.

Color.description: Hexadecimal value of the color used to help organize the UserDefinedLabel records.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record indirectly. For example, accessed through a list view or related record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, and LastReferenceDate is not null, the user accessed this record or list view indirectly. For example, accessed through a list view or related record.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: ID of the user or group that owns the label. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

TotalAssignments.description: Calculated field. Number of related UserDefinedLabelAssignment records. Available in API version 62.0 and later.

Type.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort
Type.description: Type of user-defined label. Possible values are: Starred Tag User

associated_objects:
This object has these associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, they’re available in the same API versions as this object. Otherwise, they’re available in the specified API version and later.

- **UserDefinedLabelOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **UserDefinedLabelShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
